name: Codex Spirit Companion Art Direction
goal: Move from rough programmer art toward a polished, readable, cute pixel desktop-pet style while keeping runtime assets lightweight.

principles.label: 清晰轮廓
principles.summary: 小尺寸也要一眼认出头、角、肚皮、爪子和尾巴。
principles.check: At 64px, the pet should still read as a jade Taotie spirit pet.

principles.label: 材质层次
principles.summary: 用少量高光和暗面区分玉色身体、奶油肚皮、古金角饰。
principles.check: Avoid flat color blocks; every major body part needs one highlight or shadow cue.

principles.label: 表情生命感
principles.summary: 眼睛、嘴、腮红要传达贪吃、满足、犯困、发光开心等状态。
principles.check: The mood should be readable before reading the label.

principles.label: 运行时轻量
principles.summary: 桌宠继续用程序化动画和小图标驱动，不把所有状态一次性换成大图。
principles.check: Art upgrades should not make the desktop pet slow, hard to drag, or hard to inspect.

principles.label: 装扮可扩展
principles.summary: 头部、胸颈、背部三个锚点保持稳定，后续皮肤和饰品围绕这些位置增长。
principles.check: New art should preserve head, neck, and back slots.

nextAssets: three cosmetic items: halo, jade pendant, scroll pack
